commits_data.title: MAC Blocks: Add check box and hide the short name
commits_data.message:
MAC Blocks: Add check box and hide the short name

The short name is used by Wireshark for name-resolution.
Hide it by default.

commits_data.title: MAC Blocks: Use a proxy model to implement filtering
commits_data.message:
MAC Blocks: Use a proxy model to implement filtering

Implement the search as a QSortFilterProxyModel filter, instead of
using a simpler binary search.

The only practical difference is that the dialog now shows all
entries when the input is empty, instead of an empty table.

commits_data.title: MAC Blocks: Replace QComboBox with a QLineEdit
commits_data.message:
MAC Blocks: Replace QComboBox with a QLineEdit

Use a QLineEdit for text input. It is the better choice and conforms
better with our practice.

Make radio buttons activatable. Add a QButtonGroup to connect to
the group's buttonClicked signal. Use that to activate the filter,
particularly when the Enter key is pressed.
